items.name: Zeus' thunderbolt
items.description: Weapon freed from Tartarus by Zeus, used against Titans, Typhon, Semele and Aesculapius.

items.name: the necklace of Harmonia
items.description: Cursed necklace used to bribe Eriphyle, later fought over and dedicated at Delphi.

wikipedia.lead: The Necklace of Harmonia, also called the Necklace of Eriphyle, was a fabled object in Greek mythology that, according to legend, brought great misfortune to all of its wearers or owners, who were primarily queens and princesses of the ill-fated House of Thebes.

items.name: the belt of Hippolyte
items.description: Belt of the Amazon queen, taken by Hercules for Eurystheus.

wikipedia.lead: In Greek mythology, Hippolyta, or Hippolyte, was the queen of the Amazons and a daughter of Ares and Otrera. Her sisters were Antiope and Melanippe.

items.name: the golden apples of the Hesperides
items.description: Apples guarded by a dragon, which Hercules fetches for Eurystheus as a labour.

wikipedia.lead: The Apples of the Hesperides were golden apples in Greek mythology, kept in a garden at the far western edge of the world. According to myth, the apples were a wedding gift from Gaia to Hera, and they were said to grant immortality.

items.name: the Gorgon's head
items.description: Medusa's severed head, which petrifies enemies; Perseus gives it to Athena for her shield.

items.name: the Golden Fleece
items.description: Fleece of the golden ram, kept in Colchis, which Jason sails to fetch with Medea's help.

wikipedia.lead: In Greek mythology, the Golden Fleece is the fleece of the golden-woolled, winged ram, Chrysomallos, which rescued Phrixus and brought him to Colchis, where Phrixus then sacrificed it to Zeus. Phrixus gave the fleece to King Aeëtes, who kept it in a sacred grove, whence Jason and the Argonauts stole it with the help of Medea, Aeëtes's daughter.

items.name: the Sun's goblet
items.description: Golden cup in which the Sun crosses the ocean, given to Hercules on his Geryon journey.

items.name: the brand
items.description: Brand whose burning the Fates tied to Meleager's life; Althaea hid it, then burned it.

items.name: the Argo
items.description: The ship built by Argus in which Jason and the Argonauts sail to Colchis.

wikipedia.lead: In Greek mythology, the Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts. The ship was built with divine aid and carried the Argonauts on their quest for the Golden Fleece from Iolcos to Colchis.

items.name: the Palladium
items.description: Sacred image of Athena that fell from heaven at Ilium when Ilus founded the city.

wikipedia.lead: In Greek and Roman mythology, the Palladium or Palladion was a cult image of great antiquity on which the safety of Troy and later Rome was said to depend, the wooden statue (xoanon) of Pallas Athena that Odysseus and Diomedes stole from the citadel of Troy and which was later taken to the future site of Rome by Aeneas. The Roman story is related in Virgil's Aeneid and other works.

items.name: the Delphic tripod
items.description: Apollo's oracular tripod at Delphi, which Hercules tries to seize.

wikipedia.lead: Pythia was the title of the high priestess of the Temple of Apollo at Delphi in central Greece. She served as its oracle and was known as the Oracle of Delphi.

items.name: the poisoned tunic
items.description: Tunic smeared with Nessus' blood, which burns Hercules to death.
